name: KrishokChat
description: We introduce KrishokChat, an 85,979-instance Bengali agricultural benchmark built from 284 government publications, 13 institutions, and six regional dialects. The benchmark comprises four tracks: General Knowledge QA, Treatment QA, Safety Refusal and Re-query, and Table QA. It also includes a 1,000-query Real-World Farmer Benchmark collected independently from field interviews to measure transfer to authentic farmer language. Every extracted instance retains provenance at the citation level. Treatment QA also provides a structured chemical-trace array for dosage-level auditability.
